Services

Color, cuts, and care.

Unique Salon was established in April of 2007 with the intent of offering clients a unique styling experience in a warm, relaxed atmosphere. A place to expect exceptional service, join in the camaraderie, and have fun in a stress-free environment.

Owned by local stylists Emily Kiskadden and Andrea Walker.

  • 01

    Highlights

    Lightened strands placed through the hair for brightness and dimension.

  • 02

    Lowlights

    Deeper tones woven through the hair to add depth and richness.

  • 03

    Balayage

    Hand-painted color for a soft, natural blend that grows out gently.

  • 04

    Volume weft

    Wefted extensions added for fullness, body, and extra length.

  • 05

    Color match

    Color mixed to match a shade you love or blend with your natural tone.

  • 06

    Hair cut

    A cut shaped to your hair, your face, and how you wear it day to day.

  • 07

    Waxing

    Quick, tidy hair removal with warm wax for a smooth, clean finish.
